source_title: Travis Head and Alex Carey mural unveiled in Adelaide ahead of Christmas Test - The Times of India
source_excerpt: ADELAIDE: Cricket Australia has unveiled a large mural featuring Australian cricketers Travis Head and Alex Carey in Adelaide, marking the 50-day countdown to the much-anticipated Christmas Test.The unveiling brought together cricket personalities and members of Head's family, with his wife, Jess Head, and their children attending the event to see the mural up close for the first time.Former Australian cricketers Mel Jones and Callum Ferguson were also present at the event organised by Cricket Australia.The mural celebrates two of Australia's prominent cricketers, both of whom have strong ties to South Australian cricket. The unveiling also added to the build-up to the traditional Christmas Test, one of the highlights of Australia's home summer.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.
